t.text: Screen remote on iPad: where the toolbar goes when it's away

annotations.text: My pick: A. The bottom edge goes back to iOS (no deferral), so its Home indicator fades on its own and nothing sits at the bottom. The tab is where the thumb rests holding an iPad in landscape, and the column fits the tall side.
B is the least UI, but there's nothing to tap and the first swipe-up is ours, the second iOS's: easy to land on the home screen by accident.
C covers the least of the Mac and can be moved off whatever it hides. Fine fallback if the edge tab feels too hidden.
